title: replay frame (server -> the one client that sent scrub{day}, 06)
description: snapshot + state: the world at the start of the UTC day (the latest snapshot before it plus the frames between, or the bare base). frames: the day's ev and world frames in broadcast order. metrics: the day's 5-minute metrics frames. A request that cannot be served gets {t, day?, error}: bad-day (format, future, older than 30 days; no day echoed), rate (1 scrub per 2 s per connection), unavailable (no database, or it failed).
